item.title: Over 2,000 lives saved through Small Talk Saves Lives campaign
item.description: Network Rail, British Transport Police and Samaritans have relaunched their joint campaign 'Small Talk Saves Lives'.

item.title: RAIB issues advice following incident at West London railway station
item.description: At the end of 2024, a Rail Accident Investigation Branch (RAIB) investigation was launched looking into a trap and drag incident which occurred at Ealing Broadway in November 2024.

item.title: £6.6m deal keeps London Overground ‘missing link’ on track
item.description: £6.65 million is set to be collectively contributed towards the West London Orbital route by Transport for London (TfL), four west London boroughs and the Old Oak & Park Royal Development Corporation (OPDC).

item.title: Yorkshire Wolds Railway gears up for annual model railway exhibition
item.description: Members of the Yorkshire Wolds Railway are gearing up for the annual model railway exhibition in Driffield on Saturday, 14 March. Now in its ninth year, the show runs from 10 am to 4 pm at the Rix Pavilion on Driffield Showground.

item.title: Services resume on the Brecon Mountain Railway this weekend
item.description: Following some winter maintenance and inspections, the Brecon Mountain Railway is set to return in full steam from this weekend.

item.title: New crowd management for upcoming Wales V Italy Six Nations fixture
item.description: Transport for Wales (TfW) is set to trial a new post-match crowd management plan during the upcoming Six Nations match between Wales and Italy, as preparations continue for the redevelopment of Cardiff Central station. Passengers are being asked to plan ahead and leave plenty of time for travel.

item.title: Greater Manchester set for major transport upgrades
item.description: Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) has announced the launch of a major 2026 upgrade to boost the Bee Network’s tram capacity, reliability, and resilience. The first phase runs over Easter weekend (3-6 April) at Trafford Bar and Deansgate-Castlefield, with track and rail replacement work affecting the Altrincham, Eccles, and Trafford Park lines. East Didsbury and Airport line services will operate only to Firswood.

item.title: New images released of new Birmingham Railway Station
item.description: HS2 engineers have finished installing 2,011 concrete piles to underpin the foundations of the new Curzon Street station in Birmingham.

item.title: £22,500 boost for biodiversity at Crewe Heritage Centre
item.description: The Crewe Heritage Trust has been awarded £22,500 to restore green space and biodiversity.
